verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and texting platform. It documents sharing one number with a team (quo-docs-20), and messages for each number land in Quo inboxes that can be listed and queried (quo-docs-10, quo-docs-12). That covers the core idea of team texts arriving in a shared inbox, but nothing shows the team can see which member replied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a shared team inbox for texts, per-message attribution showing who replied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
